name: undo-toast
title: Undo Toast
description: Deferred actions with an undo window: actions apply optimistically and commit only after a countdown that pauses on hover, focus or a hidden tab, with Ctrl/⌘+Z, a commit on page close (pagehide), and a rollback notice if the commit fails.

meta.stops: Deleted item gone with no undo
meta.summary: Runs actions optimistically and commits only after an undo window, so a mistake can be taken back without an "Are you sure?".
catches: Regretted actions, undone before onCommit runs
Countdown paused while hovered, focused or the tab is hidden
Leaving the page, which flushes pending commits
Failed commits, rolled back with a notice
limits: Commits on pagehide can't be awaited; use fetch keepalive or sendBeacon
If the tab crashes, a pending commit may never run
Other users may see the optimistic state only after commit
a11y: Toast region has an aria-label and polite live updates; failures use role=alert
Undo button has an aria-label with the message and aria-keyshortcuts
Ctrl/⌘+Z triggers undo when hotkey is on
